notes: «يعني ابن دينار» is an editor gloss, left out
«بهذا الحديث قال عن أم سلمة» is read as the chain continuing from محمد بن زيد to أم سلمة; «بهذا الحديث» is not one of the back-reference phrases, so no back_reference link is written

Abu Dawud's remark after the matn names another route for the same saying (through محمد بن زيد's mother, «أمه»), so it is a variant group, never a route of this report; «لم يذكر أحد منهم النبي» is the remark's own point
